comment: Variation of autodescribe-replaces-decgraphics-look-glyph that leaves getpos() with Escape after the autodescribe line (step 7) and presses Ctrl-P twice. The first (step 9) recalls the empty gt.toplines that remember_topl() left before show_topl(). The second (step 10) redraws the remembered look line through topl.c redotoplin() with ttyDisplay->mixed clear, so its 0xF1 first byte goes through putsyms() and recorder patch 006 ignores it: column 0 keeps the blank the first recall left.
